resources.string: Show the true HR shape over the painting
Lantern = low battery (a lantern on the ground under 30%)
Geese = step goal (geese cross the sky once today's goal is met)
Hiker = workout summit (a hiker on the peak a workout raised)
Village = calm hours (a village or hut when the last four hours raised no mountain)
Hour in kanji numerals (off: the hour in the same brush digits as the minutes)
Red seal shows the heart rate (off: the date, month over day)
Paint the weather over the scene (rain, snow, storm, wind)
Foreground: 0 = by season, 1 spring, 2 summer, 3 autumn, 4 winter, 5 mountain pass
